counterparty.name: UBTech Robotics (优必选)
counterparty.description: Shenzhen humanoid robot maker (Walker S series), listed on HKEX (9880.HK). Direct competitor of Unitree in China's humanoid market — UBTech leads industrial deployments (BYD, Geely factories) while Unitree leads volume and research-market share.

relationship.summary: UBTech and Unitree are direct competitors in China's humanoid robot market: industry comparisons place them in the top tier (Unitree ~18,000 cumulative bipedal humanoids vs UBTech ~3,000 by 2026-08) with diverging strategies — Unitree on cost/volume, UBTech on industrial deployments (Walker S in BYD/Geely lines).

candidates.title: 宇树拿下'人形机器人'第一 18000台量产领先 (中华网)
candidates.quote: 横向对比国内四家主流人形机器人企业，数据全部采用官方公开口径：宇树科技纯双足人形18000台；智元机器人纯双足人形7000台；优必选全系列人形机器人累计下线约3000台。
candidates.license_note: Public web publication; quoted for research with attribution.
candidates.agent_review_notes: direct head-to-head competitive comparison (same market, official-figures basis) = named-competitor context, passes co-occurrence guard; quantitative

candidates.title: 情感陪护机器人,不能阻止优必选股价触底 (虎嗅)
candidates.evidence_locator: Article section '三强对决: 宇树、优必选、智元的路线之争'
candidates.quote: 2026年的中国人形机器人赛道，已经形成了三足鼎立的格局。但三家公司，走的是三条截然不同的路。……优必选：全栈全场景的理想主义。
